name: schema
description: JSON Schema definitions for project.json and module.json. The foundation that defines what a valid spec looks like.

requirements.title: Define project schema
requirements.description: JSON Schema for project.json covering name, description, version, requirements (with optional priority field, integer 0-4), module declarations with inter-module dependencies, and milestones. All node IDs and cross-references are 12-character lowercase hex identity hash strings (pattern ^[a-f0-9]{12}$).

requirements.title: Define module schema
requirements.description: JSON Schema for module.json covering requirements (with required preq_id tracing to project requirements), architecture components (with content links), implementation sections (with content links), and data flows. All node IDs and cross-references are 12-character lowercase hex identity hash strings (pattern ^[a-f0-9]{12}$).

requirements.title: Embed schemas in binary
requirements.description: Make schemas available programmatically via go:embed so the validator can use them without external file dependencies.

requirements.title: Identity hash ID constraints
requirements.description: All node IDs are 12-character lowercase hex identity hash strings, unique within their containing array. The identity hash is SHA256(identity_string) truncated to the first 6 bytes (12 hex chars), where identity_string is built deterministically from the node's position in the spec graph: project requirements use 'project/requirement/<title>'; modules use 'module/<name>'; module requirements use '<module>/requirement/<title>'; components use '<module>/component/<name>'; impl_sections use '<module>/impl_section/<name>'; data_flows use '<module>/data_flow/<name>'; test_sections use '<module>/test_section/<name>'; milestones use 'milestone/<title>'; test_plan scenarios use 'test_plan/scenario/<name>'. Schema enforces the hex pattern; uniqueness enforced by validator. IDs are computed deterministically from node identity, never assigned manually — two branches that add different nodes always produce different hashes, eliminating merge collisions.

requirements.title: Define test_sections in module schema
requirements.description: Add test_sections array to module.json schema, parallel to impl_sections. Each test_section has id, name, content (path to test_*.md), and describes (component IDs).

requirements.title: Define bead-map schema
requirements.description: JSON Schema for .bead-map.json covering the envelope (next_id, records array) and record fields (id, spec_node_id, bead_id, bead_type, module, component, content_file, spec_hash, optional bead_status). The spec_node_id field is validated against the identity hash pattern ^[a-f0-9]{12}$ — the same format used by node IDs in project.json and module.json — so the merkle tree key and the mapping store key are byte-identical and need no translation. The internal record `id` remains an integer, since it is used only for the spex:<id> bead label and is never referenced from the spec graph.

requirements.title: Define sections array in project schema
requirements.description: Add a sections array to project.json schema. Each entry requires id (string identity hash), name (string), type (string). Additional properties allowed on section entries (freeform content validated externally by coupled module schemas).

requirements.title: Define section.schema.json convention
requirements.description: Document and enforce the convention that coupled modules provide a section.schema.json in their spec directory. This file is a standard JSON Schema that validates the freeform content of the module's project-level section.

requirements.title: Identity hash algorithm
requirements.description: Provide a deterministic identity hash function shared across the schema, validator, merkle, impact, apply, and map modules. Given a sequence of identity-string parts, the function joins them with '/', computes SHA256, and returns the first 6 bytes as a 12-character lowercase hex string. Same parts in same order always produce the same hash. The function lives in the schema package because it defines what IDs look like; all other modules import it rather than reimplement it.

components.name: ProjectSchema
components.description: The project.json JSON Schema definition. Defines the structure for project metadata, requirements (including optional priority integer 0-4), module declarations, and milestones.

components.name: ModuleSchema
components.description: The module.json JSON Schema definition. Defines the structure for module requirements (with preq_id required), components, impl_sections, test_sections, and data_flows.

components.name: SchemaLoader
components.description: Go package that embeds JSON Schema files and exposes them for programmatic use by the validator and other modules. Also exposes the IdentityHash utility function used to compute deterministic 12-character hex node IDs from identity strings.

components.name: BeadMapSchema
components.description: The .bead-map.json JSON Schema definition. Defines the structure for the mapping envelope (next_id, records) and individual mapping records including bead_type field.
